label: No placebo
rationale: This is a prospective, single-arm, open-label trial with no comparator arm described. Participants receive IVIg, and the only additional procedure is focused ultrasound with microbubbles to open the blood-brain barrier, which is a sham-free interventional procedure rather than a placebo control.

evidence.quote: Six participants will be enrolled in two sequential cohorts
ALS patients will be assigned to receive Intravenous Immunoglobulin
The first dose at Week 0 will be a standalone

title: Intravenous Immunoglobulin (IVIG) and Blood-Brain Barrier Disruption in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
